summary: Jinko Holdings filed a 6-K attaching two press releases: third-quarter 2026 results and a CFO transition. Q3 revenue was RMB13.62 billion (US$2.03 billion), up 10.2% sequentially but down 15.7% year-over-year, with module shipments of 15,003 MW and gross margin of 12.3%. Net loss attributable to ordinary shareholders narrowed to RMB170.0 million. The filing also discloses roughly RMB330 million of new and follow-on strategic investments and a RMB38.7 million exit from LAPLACE. No transaction, tender, or structural event; watch the CFO transition and margin trajectory.
